definitions.explanation: Attached to a Sino-Japanese noun to name a stretch of land, a climatic region, or a range on a scale: {温帯|おんたい} (temperate zone), {火山帯|かざんたい} (volcanic belt), {時間帯|じかんたい} (time slot).

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{多|おお}くは{温帯|おんたい}にある。
examples.english: Most of Japan lies in the temperate zone.

examples.japanese: この{時間帯|じかんたい}は{電車|でんしゃ}が{混|こ}む。
examples.english: The trains are crowded during this time slot.

examples.japanese: {熱帯|ねったい}の{島|しま}では、{一年中|いちねんじゅう}{気温|きおん}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: On tropical islands the temperature is high all year round.

examples.japanese: {日本列島|にほんれっとう}は{火山帯|かざんたい}の{上|うえ}にあるため、{地震|じしん}や{噴火|ふんか}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Because the Japanese archipelago sits on a volcanic belt, it has many earthquakes and eruptions.

notes:
From {帯|おび} (sash, belt), read たい in compounds. The image is a long band — of land, of climate, or of values along a scale.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温帯|おんたい}: temperate zone
- {熱帯|ねったい}: tropics
- {寒帯|かんたい}: frigid zone
- {火山帯|かざんたい}: volcanic belt
- {時間帯|じかんたい}: time slot, time band
- {価格帯|かかくたい}: price range

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜{域|いき}: area, region — marks a bounded area rather than a band ({流域|りゅういき}, river basin)
- 〜{層|そう}: layer, stratum — a layer stacked with others, including social strata ({年齢層|ねんれいそう}, age group)
